verdict.rationale: Reflect is a note-taking SaaS, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. The OAuth REST API and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks someone could use to construct one, not the capability itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
